# Yandex

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/yandex/images - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Yandex image results for a query, 30 a page, in the row shape of GET /v1/bing/images. Each image has an id stable across pages, its position, the title, the full-size image with its width and height, the thumbnail, the page it sits on and the site, plus Yandex's snippet (`description`) and the image's file size in bytes (`file_size_bytes`). Filter by color, type (photo, clipart, lineart, demotivator, face), file_type (jpg, png, gifan for animated GIFs), aspect (square, wide, tall), site (one source website) and recent=true (images from the last seven days). domain picks the Yandex edition and safe_search the family filter. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to collect images for a query with colour, type, file type, aspect, site or recency filters.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈30/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - What to search for, up to 2,048 characters. · e.g. `golden retriever`
- `domain` (optional, enum: yandex.com | yandex.ru | yandex.by | yandex.kz | yandex.uz | yandex.com.tr) - yandex.com (default), yandex.ru, yandex.by, yandex.kz, yandex.uz or yandex.com.tr.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: off | moderate | strict) - strict, moderate (default) or off.
- `color` (optional, enum: color | gray | red | orange | yellow | cyan | green | blue | violet | white | black) - One of color (in colour), gray (black and white), red, orange, yellow, cyan, green, blue, violet, white, black (a dominant colour).
- `type` (optional, enum: photo | clipart | lineart | demotivator | face) - photo, clipart, lineart, demotivator or face.
- `file_type` (optional, enum: jpg | png | gifan) - jpg, png or gifan (animated GIF).
- `aspect` (optional, enum: square | wide | tall) - square, wide or tall.
- `site` (optional, string) - Only images from this website, for example wikipedia.org.
- `recent` (optional, enum: true | false) - true for images Yandex found in the last seven days.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The next_cursor from a previous page of the same search. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `MediaList` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {id string, position number, title string, image_url string, thumbnail_url string, width number, height number, thumbnail_width null, thumbnail_height null, page_url string, source string, description string, file_size_bytes number}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yandex/images" \
  --data-urlencode "query=golden retriever" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/yandex/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Yandex's organic results for a query, 10 a page for up to 10 pages. Each result has its position, title, link, the site as Yandex shows it and the domain; Yandex results carry no snippet. Choose the Yandex site (yandex.com by default, or yandex.ru, .by, .kz, .uz, .com.tr), the language, newest first or by relevance, how recent, and safe search. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to see rankings in Russian-speaking and Turkish markets, choosing yandex.ru, yandex.com.tr or another Yandex site.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 10/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, up to 400 characters, for example heat pump efficiency. · e.g. `heat pump efficiency`
- `domain` (optional, enum: yandex.com | yandex.ru | yandex.by | yandex.kz | yandex.uz | yandex.com.tr) - yandex.com (default), yandex.ru, yandex.by, yandex.kz, yandex.uz or yandex.com.tr.
- `language` (optional, string) - Two-letter search language, for example en or ru. Default en on yandex.com.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: relevance | date) - relevance (default) or date.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | two_weeks | month) - any (default), day, two_weeks or month.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate (default) or off.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Page number from 1 to 10. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (from the response contract): {date string|null, displayed_url string|null, domain string|null, position number|null, site_name string|null, snippet string|null, title string|null, url string|null}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.related_searches`, `data.total_results`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/yandex/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=heat pump efficiency" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
